theorems.name: Submission.mvk_laplacian_comp_add_smul
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (x₀ : Rn n) (σ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 h → ∀ z : Rn n, Laplacian.laplacian (fun y => h (x₀ + σ • y)) z = σ ^ 2 * Laplacian.laplacian h (x₀ + σ • z)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
